note: Family-run river camp on the Lower Colorado near Palo Verde, between Blythe and Yuma, bordering Cibola NWR: a dry-camping flat along the riverbank plus full-hookup rows held mostly by long-term trailers, with store, beer bar, fuel dock and a boat launch out of the current. Desert jeep and dirt-bike trails surround it. --Claude
summary: Operator pages read (rates updated June 2026). Fees confirmed: $27 dry camping, $45 hookup. WATERFRONT UPGRADE CANDIDATE riverview -> riverfront: the nightly dry-camp flat meets the river at ~20 m over open ground with a gentle bank, while the hookup rows stay ~60 m back behind brush. LONG-STAY concern: the hookup rows look mostly long-term; the dry camping is clearly nightly. Google 4.4 (26).
flags: FEES: stored manual fees ($27-45, read 2026-11-07) re-confirmed on the rates page 2026-11-27; group not rewritten.

WATERFRONT UPGRADE CANDIDATE riverview -> riverfront (Colorado River, well over 30 m wide). The dry-camping 'Beach Area' (gallery photos 'Dry-Camping_Beach-Area', 'South-Beach-Area'), a packed gravel flat with bank posts, reaches the riverbank at ~20 m over open ground on Esri imagery, e.g. 33.24286,-114.68914 and 33.24238,-114.68885; the bank is low and gentle (kayak test passes). Sold by the night: 'Dry Camping : $27 per day/vehicle up to 4 people'. No numbered sites, it is an open dry-camp area. The full-hookup rows (around 33.24424,-114.69007 at their east end) are 55-65 m back behind riparian brush, so a riverfront value would apply to dry camping only and needs that caveat in the note. Stored evidence ('RV loops ... set back ~150-200m') measured the hookup rows only.

LONG-STAY: about 60 trailers on imagery in the hook-up rows, many with fixed shade structures; the rates page leads with 'Setting up your trailer on this year-round site makes for turnkey use' and long-term sites cost $390 a month plus electricity, against $45 a day; about-it: 'some having had their trailers here for 40+ years'. The nightly share of hookup sites can't be measured (no engine), but the dry-camp flat is plainly nightly ('Sites available by the day, night, week and month'). Report, not a clear drop.
OHV: 'We are surrounded by a vast desert for off roading' - a general river campground with OHV nearby, not a staging camp.
GOOGLE: 4.4 from 26 reviews. PRICE: $45 top rate, under the gate.
EXTRA PEOPLE: dry camping covers 'up to 4 people' per vehicle; no per-person charge is posted beyond the group rate ($10 per person per day), so nothing written.
ELECTRIC: amperage not posted; left unset.
PHONE 760-854-3322 matches Google (the site lists only email havefun@walterscamp.com). WEBSITE current; could point at https://walterscamp.com/rates/.
